But the recent action points the other way. The coin is down 68% over the last 15 minutes and 79% from its 30-minute high, with net flow of -78 SOL and sellers outnumbering buyers. Sell volume is almost equal to buy volume, and the top three holders control 96% of the curve, which means the early tape is concentrated and the distribution is still underway. The 30-minute return is positive only because the coin ran before this dump.

Nothing here shows demand that will still be present in 30-60 minutes. Buying a coin in a 79% drawdown with sellers in control is catching a falling knife on a base rate that already loses money. I'd skip this one.
